name: 学情分析报告 · 高中
description_zh: 为高中教师把考试成绩 / 题目得分明细 / 知识点掌握表 转化为多维诊断报告：班级整体表现、高中低分段画像、易错题分析、薄弱知识点、3-2-1 教学建议。触发关键词：学情分析、成绩分析、考试分析、薄弱知识点、教学诊断、高中学情。
description_en: Transforms exam scores / item score details / knowledge-point mastery tables into a multi-dimensional diagnostic report for senior high teachers: overall class performance, high/middle/low score-band profiles, error-prone question analysis, weak knowledge points, and 3-2-1 teaching recommendations. Trigger keywords: learning analysis, score analysis, exam analysis, weak knowledge points, teaching diagnosis, senior high learning analysis.
